derivation_instead_of_rebinding.decision: J19B is a MECHANICAL, AUDITABLE COPY of the J16 runner. J16 itself is byte-unchanged.

how_the_copy_is_produced.why_a_tool_and_not_a_hand_written_copy: retyping 1737 lines of a safety-critical closed-loop path by hand is precisely the silent-divergence risk the mechanical-copy requirement exists to prevent: one mistyped constant would not announce itself. The transformation is therefore the auditable artefact, and it is a closed, pinned map.
